catalogue_metadata.metadata_note: Non-coordinate catalogue columns are metadata. An anomaly_score column is retained as an external within-image ranking. It is not used as a significance or as an artefact probability. The live NGRST-Discovery-Toolkit schema was not readable from this environment, so this alias list is unverified against that repository.

evidence.description: A per-pixel DQ array was read and decoded with bitwise tests.
evidence.interpretation: Flag names come from the dictionary recorded in the manifest. A clear pixel is not evidence of astrophysical reality.
evidence.threshold_or_policy: bitwise AND against the flag dictionary

evidence.description: Central pixel DQ decomposes to JUMP_DET
evidence.interpretation: Every set bit is listed. Combined flags are not collapsed to one integer label.
Pixels with DO_NOT_USE are left out of the default statistics, including when other bits are set. The fraction is not an artefact probability.
evidence.threshold_or_policy: exclude DO_NOT_USE from statistics when policy is exclude_do_not_use

evidence.description: Candidate aperture overlaps pixels flagged JUMP_DET.
evidence.interpretation: Ramp fitting recorded a jump. Jumps are associated with cosmic-ray hits and with other discontinuities. A jump flag does not prove that this candidate is a cosmic ray.
evidence.threshold_or_policy: fraction of on-image aperture pixel centers

evidence.description: No unknown DQ bits were set in the aperture.
evidence.interpretation: This check uses the dictionary provenance in the manifest. It does not add names for reserved bits.
Annulus flags inform the background mask. They are not by themselves a claim about the candidate's origin.

evidence.description: 0 aperture pixels have non-finite science values.
evidence.interpretation: Non-finite samples are excluded from statistics and are not replaced with zeros.

evidence.description: Aperture coverage relative to the image boundary.
evidence.interpretation: Off-image pixel centers are counted in n_off_image and omitted from fractions. They are not treated as good pixels.
Ratio of central excess to the supplied error under uncertainty_model=synthetic_gaussian_sigma. This is not a Roman calibrated variance and not an artefact probability.
evidence.threshold_or_policy: finite, positive, and not inconsistent with a complete variance budget

evidence.interpretation: The sky estimate uses unmasked annulus pixels only. It is not a source flux.
evidence.threshold_or_policy: at least 30 valid pixels; estimator sigma_clip_median

evidence.description: Central excess divided by the supplied central error.
evidence.interpretation: Ratio of central excess to the supplied error under uncertainty_model=synthetic_gaussian_sigma. This is not a Roman calibrated variance and not an artefact probability.
evidence.source_field: science and err at central pixel
evidence.threshold_or_policy: quoted only with a finite positive error and a measured background

evidence.interpretation: Area, axis ratio, and concentration describe the pixels above threshold. They do not establish an instrumental or astrophysical origin.

evidence.description: The isolated-pixel heuristic did not trigger.
evidence.interpretation: Absence of this heuristic is not a cosmic-ray rejection and not a confirmation of a real source.
No reference PSF was applied. A missing PSF comparison does not mean the candidate matches a Roman PSF.
evidence.threshold_or_policy: reference model required; Gaussian toy is not a Roman PSF

evidence.description: Count of aperture pixels accepted by the DQ and finite-value policy.
evidence.interpretation: This count is the sample available for local statistics after the stated mask.

limitations: RomanArtifactLens is a diagnostic assistant. It does not classify candidates as alien, novel, extragalactic, cosmic-ray, instrumental, or not real.
Multi-exposure persistence, filter-to-filter, and transient comparisons are NOT_EVALUATED in v0.1. Raw detector indices are not treated as co-registered.
L3 context-to-L2 contributor inspection is NOT_EVALUATED unless a later version is given both the context map and the L2 products.
SYNTHETIC_TEST: this image was generated inside RomanArtifactLens. It is not a Roman-calibrated exposure and it does not use a Roman observation identifier.
PSF comparison: NOT_EVALUATED. No Roman PSF residual is shown.

uncertainty.assumption: Ratio of central excess to the supplied error under uncertainty_model=synthetic_gaussian_sigma. This is not a Roman calibrated variance and not an artefact probability.

not_concluded: This packet does not establish that the candidate is astrophysically real.
This packet does not establish that the candidate is an instrumental artefact.
A DQ flag records a pipeline or reference-file condition, not a complete physical origin.

position.coordinate_convention: 0-based pixel centers; x is the column index and y is the row index; science[y, x] is the central sample when x and y are integers. NumPy round-half-to-even selects the central pixel.

units_note: Units come from the synthetic file. They are not Roman-calibrated units.
